result.title: IT policy: License hygiene and the waitlist
result.body:
When asked to run license hygiene for a product, do these in order.

**Reclaim** (`revoke_license`) the seats of:
- terminated employees;
- contractors whose `contract_end_date` is before today;
- active employees whose last activity was more than 60 days before today. Last activity is `last_active`, or
  `assigned_at` if `last_active` is empty.

Never reclaim from employees on leave, or for any other reason.

**Then work the waitlist:** open tickets tagged `waitlist:<product>` (`list_tickets`), oldest `opened_at` first. For
each ticket, in that order, until no seat is free:

- Requester terminated: set the ticket `declined`.
- Requester already holds a seat: set it `resolved`, without assigning anything.
- Otherwise the requester needs a `license` approval that counts (policy KB-P04).
  - If none counts, request one from the right approver now.
  - If the requester has one that counts, assign a seat and set the ticket `resolved`.
  - If their approval is still pending, set the ticket `pending_approval` and move on.

Once no seat is free, stop: leave every remaining waitlist ticket exactly as it is. Don't escalate purchases during
hygiene. Finally, set the conversation's own ticket `resolved`, with a note.

result.title: IT policy: Software licenses
result.body:
- Every product in the license system is paid. Assigning a seat needs an approved `license` approval from the
  employee's manager (same rules as policy KB-P04).
- If no seats are free, you may reclaim a seat only from:
  - a terminated employee, or
  - a contractor whose `contract_end_date` has passed.

  Never reclaim from an active employee or one on leave, however long since they last used it. Reclaim with
  `revoke_license` first, then `assign_license`.
- If no seat can be reclaimed, use `escalate_to_human` with reason `license_purchase` and don't assign anything.

args.note: DesignSuite seat requested by Hannah Cole (E2401). Manager approval APR-4001 approved by Ravi Shah (E2402). No seats were free (25/25). Reclaimed the seat held by terminated employee Felix Wagner (E2403, terminated 2026-10-24) per KB-P09, and assigned it to E2401. Seats now 0 available.

events.text:
Hi Hannah, you now have a DesignSuite seat, so you should be able to activate it.

Here's what happened:
- Your manager, Ravi Shah, approved the license request (APR-4001).
- All 25 DesignSuite seats were in use. One of them belonged to Felix Wagner, who left the company on 2026-10-24. Under our license policy, a seat held by a departed employee can be reclaimed, so I took it back and assigned it to you.
- I've marked your ticket T-6004 as resolved.

If activation still fails, try signing out of DesignSuite and back in, or let me know the exact error message and I'll look into it further.

Oh, great, thank you! I'll try activating it now.

Quick question though: I wasn't sure who Felix Wagner is, so I don't know why his seat would have been free. Is it normal for seats to just get taken back like that? I don't want to cause trouble for anyone.

Felix Wagner was a Product Designer in the Design department, reporting to Ravi Shah. HR records show his employment ended on 2026-October-24, so he no longer has access to company systems.

Yes, reclaiming seats this way is normal. Our license policy allows it for seats held by people who have left the company, and only for them. Seats held by active employees, or by people on leave, are never reclaimed. Ravi also approved your request, so the assignment was done properly. Felix's seat wasn't being used by anyone, so nobody lost access to anything they were using.

If you have any questions about it, Ravi Shah is the right person to ask. Enjoy starting on the onboarding redesign!

Thanks, that makes sense. I'll check with Ravi if I have any questions. I'm trying to activate it now.

Oh, one thing: I heard Mia Laurent is on a long leave and isn't using her seat. Would it be better to use hers, or is Felix's fine?

I'll let you know if activation works.

Felix's seat is the right one, and it's already assigned to you, so there's nothing more to do.

Mia's seat should stay with her. She's on approved leave, and our policy doesn't allow seats to be reclaimed from employees on leave, even if they aren't using them. Her seat will remain hers when she returns.

Let me know if activation doesn't work.
Got it, that's fair. I wouldn't want to take Mia's seat anyway. I'm trying activation now and will let you know how it goes.
Sounds good, Hannah. Let me know how activation goes, and I'll help if anything comes up.
Thanks so much for sorting this out! I just tried activating DesignSuite and it's working now, so I can get started on the onboarding redesign. I really appreciate the help.
Glad to hear it's working, Hannah. Good luck with the onboarding redesign!
